question: Alarmingly, some governments have sought to apply their online safety laws extraterritorially because the use of VPNs and similar circumvention technologies enables users to bypass such laws.

Given this, I request a clear answer from the Commission to the following question: Does the Digital Services Act1, Commission guidance or any EU law require or encourage platforms to implement compliance measures beyond geo-blocking illegal content in the relevant EU jurisdiction, such as removing content globally, because some EU users use a VPN?

Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 19 October 2022 on a Single Market For Digital Services and amending Directive 2000/31/EC (Digital Services Act) (OJ L 277, 27.10.2022, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2022/2065/oj). 1
